name: meteorite_mana_tap.json
notes: Meteorite's second head: the printed '{T}: Add one mana of any color'. Mana abilities are no menu rows (2026-11-11): a game activates one only while a cost is paid, the payer choosing the source and its colour (CR 605.3a), so the pack pays through a cast with "tap": true or the menu (act). The pool's {C} pays Keen Glidemaster's {1}, and only Meteorite, making blue, pays its {U}: the 2/1 enters and Meteorite taps. Meteorite starts on the battlefield (its ETB damage already 'happened', a prior turn), so this pack isolates its mana ability.
